one_liner: One end-to-end composition flow: live Chain MCP reads (by tool name, mainnet) feed a SkillEngine preflight skill whose ALLOW/BLOCK verdict depends on nothing but that data — proven by contrast runs quoting the same live balance.
what_it_does: This lamp shows the full loop: live reads from the chain via the Chain MCP's named tools, a SkillEngine preflight skill that verdicts ALLOW or BLOCK on nothing but that data, then fresh chain queries to verify the verdict — nothing is hard-coded. Proven by live Chain MCP tool calls on Pharos mainnet (1672); the skill never signs or broadcasts — mainnet is real funds.
